title: 第四章：武器与货币
content_zh:
枪声逐渐平息，受伤者的哀嚎声传来。
暗中观察的苏晓，感觉时机已经成熟，彪形大汉托比一方，已经将敌方的流民打退。
流民们的战斗毫无策略可言，一番乱射后，就开始胡乱追击。
从房屋中翻出，苏晓平稳落地，但马上就将身体压低。
映入眼帘的情景，是连绵不断的垃圾山，青烟在垃圾山上升腾而起，一股腐臭味直冲入鼻。
苏晓没去管这些，眼睛紧盯着远处地上的一把枪，那是一把短柄燧发枪，虽然有些破旧，但却是一把能杀人的凶器。
短柄燧发枪的主人已经死亡，小半个喉咙被流弹打碎，死相极惨。
可能是死亡的位置比较隐蔽，彪形大汉托比的势力，并没有发现这把枪，否则在武器稀缺的‘废品终点站’。绝不会将这把‘短柄燧发枪’扔在这。
低俯身体，苏晓开始向那把枪靠近。
但就在此时，一名身体消瘦的流民，已经冲到那把‘短柄燧发枪’前，那满是污垢的手掌，抓向‘短柄燧发枪’。
苏晓眉头皱起，并不是因为对方抢占了先机，而是怕对方引起那两伙势力的注意。
随手捡起一块拳头大小的石块，苏晓全力将石块抛出。
石块带起极强的力道，狠狠砸在流民的手臂上。
“砰。”
流民被打了一个踉跄，同时发出一声惨嚎。
苏晓急步冲到对方身后，身体侧偏，膝盖狠顶在流民的脊柱上。
流民身体前弓曲，口水喷出一股酸水，但就算受到如此重击，那流民居然只是向前踉跄两步，并没有倒下。
苏晓瞳孔一阵紧缩，海贼世界的人类，身体素质到底有多强，这还只是身体素质最差的流民而已。
但此刻已经顾不上那些，苏晓发现那流民已经目露凶光，仿佛被激怒的野兽般，满口黄牙咬紧，咬合肌突出。
这幅狰狞的模样，如果换做普通人，一定会下意识退后，但苏晓不同，他有战斗的经验，心中明白，如果这时逃，那裸露出的后背就会挨上一枪。

拳头紧握，苏晓在流民还没恢复来时，已经一拳打在对方下颚。
人体下颚处分布着大量血管，如果突然遭到重击，会导致脑供血不足，之后引发供氧不足，短时间昏迷。
“砰。”几颗带血的黄牙飞出老远。
挨了苏晓全力一拳后，流民直挺挺的向后倒去，仿佛一根栽倒的木棍般。
普通人被击中下颚，会昏厥几十秒，但海贼世界的土著体质都迷之强大，所以苏晓将流民的身体翻过，瞄准对方后颈又是一拳。
砰的一声闷响，流民生死不知。
苏晓抓起地上那把‘短柄燧发枪’，马上有一行文字出现在他眼前。
还没等苏晓查看，远处隐约跑来一大群人，是追击失败的托比势力。
苏晓心中一阵发寒，在这时一旦被发现，他可能连说话的机会都没有，会被直接打成筛子，这些人都已经杀红眼。
左右扫视一番，苏晓脸色有些难看，他所处的位置，四周全是高耸的垃圾山，这些垃圾山成环形，将四周遮挡。
苏晓可不敢爬上那极不稳定的垃圾山，垃圾山随时都有塌陷的可能，其中不知道掩埋着什么，如果倒霉被利器刺中，在这种恶劣的环境下，就算不死于失血过多，也会死于感染。
所以苏晓只能翻进那间破旧的房屋中，那位叫米娅的少女，正面带惧色的看着他。
这次不用苏晓提醒，米亚主动开口。
“我不说话。”
察觉到自己已经说话，米亚赶紧将双手握在嘴上，目光还瞟向苏晓手中那把‘短柄燧发枪’。
在苏晓进入房屋后不久，嘈杂的声音在外面传来。
一阵怒骂后，外面逐渐安静下来，看来那些人是回来搜刮物资，但听那充满愤怒的声音，收获明显不怎么样。
苏晓松了口气，开始查看之前出现的提示。
【获得，破旧的燧发枪（白色）】
破旧的燧发枪（白色）

产地：海贼王，利奥波特作坊
耐久度：6/30
填弹数：4/6(连射燧发枪为海贼王世界特有技术）
攻击力：2~13（根据距离计算）
装备需求：力量1点可使用，力量超过3点可灵活使用。
评分：3（注：白色装备评分为1到10，评分为10的白色装备，将标注‘稀有’，附加特殊属性。）
简介：这是一把缺乏保养的燧发枪，这让它高达9点的评分下滑到3点，请谨慎使用它，或许下一枪就是它最后的一枪，也是你最后的一枪。
价格：150乐园币（此物品为几率拾取物品，无法带出海贼王世界）。
【猎杀者初次获得装备，开始装备品级介绍】
【装备分为，白色、绿色、蓝色……，阶位不足无法获得以下资料，请猎杀者自行摸索。】
【猎杀者初次接触乐园币，开始乐园币讲解。】
【使用乐园币可与轮回乐园或其他契约者进行交易，此为轮回乐园唯一通用货币】
【警告；请谨慎使用每一枚乐园币，因为那是你生存或变强的资本。】
苏晓若有思索的点头，看来轮回乐园有着严禁的制度，不仅将各种武器性能标注，并且还有完善的货币机制。
虽然苏晓知道接下来会经历许多危险，但他心中却有些期待，期待轮回乐园能让他变强。
虽然他现在还不清楚变强的方法，但‘轮回乐园’中一定有这种方法，否则他无法完成今后更加困难的任务。
仔细检查一番手中的【破旧的燧发枪】，苏晓脸上露出笑意。
终于有了一把武器，不然在这充满危险的世界中，他难以心安。
但相比起枪械，苏晓更喜欢使用冷兵器，比如刀，那种刀锋细窄，异常锋利的长刀。
如果他的配刀在身边，苏晓的战斗力最少提升五成。

基本情况苏晓已经了解，现在就需要准备完成任务，任务时限只是七十二小时，
苏晓不想尝试任务失败会怎样，所以他只能全身心投入到任务的完成中。
可想要刺杀一个国家的国王，绝对不是简单的事，那就需要一些其他办法，至少也要能靠近那位国王。
秘密潜入王宫的想法，苏晓从未有过，因为在海贼世界，有种东西叫做见闻色霸气。
根据苏晓的记忆，这位国王应该是与世界贵族天龙人有关，身边就算出现精通见闻色霸气的高手，也不是没有可能。
不然凭苏晓的暗杀能力，杀死一位国王的任务难度，绝不可能是lv.3.
在满是监控设备的现实世界，苏晓都能实现复仇计划，更何况是在科技落后的海贼世界？
但现在想这些还太早，首要的事，是了解他所处的位置，‘轮回乐园’可没有地图这种功能，什么都要靠他自行摸索。
苏晓的目光，看向那躲在墙角的少女，对方就生活在‘废品终点站’，对这里一定很了解。
在察觉到苏晓的目光后，少女米亚身体蜷缩起来。
“你要做什么。”
少女的声音有些颤抖，还带着哭腔，她一直隐藏性别，因为在废品终点站，女人是一种很危险的性别。
“你饿吗？”
苏晓蹲在少女面前，脸上露出温和的笑意，但他的双眼中却有些冷冽。
他不是一个善良的人，仇恨早就抹去他心中的善良。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
The gunfire gradually subsided, and the wails of the wounded could be heard.
Su Xiao, who was observing secretly, felt that the time was ripe. The burly man Tobi had already driven back the enemy refugees.
The refugees fought without any strategy. After shooting randomly, they began to pursue randomly.
Turning out of the house, Su Xiao landed smoothly, but immediately lowered her body.
The scene that came into view was a continuous mountain of garbage. Green smoke was rising from the garbage mountain, and a putrid smell rushed straight into the nose.
Su Xiao didn't care about this, and stared at a gun on the ground in the distance. It was a short-handled flintlock gun. Although it was a little worn, it was a murderous weapon.
The owner of the short-handled flintlock gun was dead. Half of his throat was shattered by a stray bullet. He died in a miserable manner.
It may be that the location of death is relatively hidden, and the powerful man Toby's forces did not find this gun, otherwise it would be in the 'Scrap Terminal' where weapons are scarce. This 'short-handled flintlock' would never be left here.
Lowering his body, Su Xiao began to approach the gun.
But at this moment, a thin refugee rushed to the 'short-handled flintlock gun' and grabbed the 'short-handled flintlock gun' with his dirt-covered palms.
Su Xiao frowned, not because the other party had seized the opportunity, but because he was afraid that the other party would attract the attention of the two groups of forces.
Picking up a fist-sized stone, Su Xiao threw the stone with all his strength.
The stone hit the refugee's arm with great force.
"Bang."
The refugee was staggered and let out a miserable howl.
Su Xiao hurriedly rushed behind the opponent, turned her body to the side, and put her knee hard on the refugee's spine.
The refugee's body bowed forward, spitting out a stream of acidic water, but even after receiving such a heavy blow, the refugee only staggered forward two steps and did not fall down.
Su Xiao's pupils tightened for a while. How strong are the physical fitness of humans in the pirate world? These are just the refugees with the worst physical fitness.
But at this moment, he could no longer care about that. Su Xiao found that the refugee had a fierce look in his eyes, like an enraged beast, with his yellow teeth clenched and his jaw muscles protruding.
With this ferocious appearance, an ordinary person would definitely retreat subconsciously, but Su Xiao was different. He had fighting experience and knew in his heart that if he ran away at this time, his exposed back would be shot.
Clenching her fists, Su Xiao punched the refugee in the jaw before he could recover.
There are a large number of blood vessels distributed in the human jaw. If a sudden blow occurs, it will cause insufficient blood supply to the brain, and then lead to insufficient oxygen supply and short-term coma.
"Bang." Several bloody yellow teeth flew far away.
After receiving a full punch from Su Xiao, the refugee fell backwards, like a fallen stick.
Ordinary people would faint for dozens of seconds if they were hit in the jaw, but the indigenous people in the pirate world had extremely strong physiques, so Su Xiao turned the refugee's body over and aimed another punch at the back of the opponent's neck.
There was a muffled bang, and the refugees did not know whether they were alive or dead.
Su Xiao grabbed the 'short-handled flintlock gun' on the ground, and a line of text immediately appeared in front of him.
Before Su Xiao could check, a large group of people loomed in the distance. They were Toby's forces who had failed in their pursuit.
Su Xiao felt a chill in her heart. Once discovered at this moment, he might not even have a chance to speak, and he would be beaten directly into a sieve. These people have already killed him.
After glancing around, Su Xiao's face looked a little ugly. Where he was, he was surrounded by towering garbage mountains. These garbage mountains formed a ring and blocked the surrounding area.
Su Xiao did not dare to climb up the extremely unstable garbage mountain. The garbage mountain might collapse at any time, and there was no telling what was buried in it. If he was unlucky enough to be stabbed by a sharp weapon, in such a harsh environment, he would die of infection even if he did not die of excessive blood loss.
So Su Xiao could only go into the dilapidated house. The girl named Mia looked at him with fear.
No need for Lidya Su to remind me this time, Mia took the initiativeOpen your mouth.
"I won't speak."
Realizing that she had spoken, Mia quickly put her hands on her mouth and glanced at the 'short-handled flintlock' in Su Xiao's hand.
Soon after Su Xiao entered the house, noisy sounds came from outside.
After a while of yelling, the outside gradually became quiet. It seemed that those people were back to search for supplies, but listening to the angry voices, the harvest was obviously not good.
Su Xiao breathed a sigh of relief and began to check the previous prompts.
[Obtained, worn-out flintlock gun (white)]
Worn Flintlock (White)
Place of Origin: One Piece, Leopold's Workshop
Durability: 6/30
Number of reloads: 4/6 (the continuous-fire flintlock gun is a unique technology in the One Piece world)
Attack power: 2~13 (calculated based on distance)
Equipment requirements: 1 point of strength can be used, and more than 3 points of strength can be used flexibly.
Rating: 3 (Note: The rating of white equipment is from 1 to 10. White equipment with a rating of 10 will be marked as 'rare' and have special attributes attached.)
Introduction: This is a flintlock gun that lacks maintenance, which makes its score drop from 9 points to 3 points. Please use it with caution. Maybe the next shot will be its last shot and your last shot.
Price: 150 Paradise Coins (this item is a chance to be picked up and cannot be taken out of the One Piece world).
[The hunter obtains equipment for the first time and begins the equipment level introduction]
[Equipment is divided into white, green, blue..., the following information cannot be obtained if the rank is insufficient, please explore by yourself. 】
[Hunter comes into contact with Paradise Coin for the first time, and begins to explain Paradise Coin. 】
[Use paradise coins to trade with Samsara Paradise or other contractors. This is the only common currency of Samsara Paradise]
[Warning: Please use every paradise coin carefully, because it is your capital to survive or become stronger. 】
Su Xiaoruo nodded thoughtfully. It seemed that Samsara Paradise had a strict prohibition system. It not only marked the performance of various weapons, but also had a complete currency mechanism.
Although Su Xiao knew that he would experience many dangers next, he had some expectations in his heart, hoping that Samsara Paradise would make him stronger.
Although he still doesn't know how to become stronger, there must be such a method in the 'Reincarnation Paradise', otherwise he will not be able to complete more difficult tasks in the future.
After carefully examining the [shabby flintlock gun] in his hand, Su Xiao showed a smile on his face.
Finally he had a weapon, otherwise he would not have peace of mind in this dangerous world.
But compared to firearms, Su Xiao prefers to use cold weapons, such as knives, long knives with narrow blades and extremely sharp edges.
If his sword is with him, Su Xiao's combat effectiveness will increase by at least 50%.
Su Xiao already understands the basic situation and needs to prepare to complete the task now. The task time limit is only seventy-two hours.
Su Xiao didn't want to try what would happen if the mission failed, so he could only devote himself to completing the mission.
But it is definitely not a simple matter to assassinate the king of a country. Then you need some other methods, at least to get close to the king.
Su Xiao has never thought of sneaking into the palace secretly, because in the world of pirates, there is something called Haki.
According to Su Xiao's memory, this king should be related to the world's noble Tianlong people. It is not impossible even if there is a master who is proficient in seeing, hearing, color and domineering around him.
Otherwise, with Su Xiao's assassination ability, the difficulty of the task of killing a king would never be lv.3.
In a real world full of surveillance equipment, Su Xiao can realize his revenge plan, let alone a pirate world with backward technology?
But it’s too early to think about this now. The first thing is to understand where he is. ‘Reincarnation Paradise’ does not have a map function, so he has to explore everything by himself.
Su Xiao looked at the girl hiding in the corner. She lived in the 'Scrap Terminal' and must know this place very well.
After noticing Lidya Su's gaze,, the girl Mia curled up.
"What are you going to do?"
The girl's voice was trembling and crying. She had been hiding her gender because women are a very dangerous gender at the scrap terminal.
"Are you hungry?"
Su Xiao squatted in front of the girl, with a gentle smile on his face, but his eyes were a little cold.
He is not a kind person, and hatred has long erased the kindness in his heart.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
